title: Shift slide and legato slide
description: Four quarter notes in two slid pairs: a shift slide up string 3 from A3 (fret 2) to C4 (fret 5), then a legato slide up string 4 from E3 (fret 2) to G3 (fret 5). The slide lives on the departing note and names its destination by note id — shift and legato differ only in whether the arrival is re-picked, so the data model is identical and the type field carries the distinction. slideIn/slideOut (no target) are the other two members of the enum. Both draw as the line between the two positions, and the legato adds the slur that says the arrival is not re-picked. On the tab staff the line is SLANTED even though both frets are on one string: drawn flat it would land exactly on the string line already there and disappear.
